spans.s: ba (IE 8-1; CII 3, etc.); an abbreviation of bahula or of bahula-pakṣa, i. e. the dark fortnight; used in connection with di or ti (see ba-di, la-ti) and also by itself. Cf. va.
Bā˚ (PJS), contraction of the honorific Bāi (q. v.) applied to ladies (especially in medieval Jain inscriptions of Western India).
